extensionDescription.message: Translate selected English text and save it to your local Word Garden.

staleExtension.message: The extension just reloaded, so this page is still running the old copy. Reload the page (⌘R / F5) and saving works again.

glossMissing.message: No meaning for this word yet

glossFromApp.message: The app fills in the meaning after you save it

savedLocal.message: Saved to the word book on this device.

queuedForApp.message: Queued — it lands in your word book when you open Word Garden.

serviceIntro.message: The extension needs the API service on this computer: open the Word Garden app for macOS and its “Background service” starts listening by itself. The AI API key is configured in the app too.

addressHint.message: The default port is 3789; keep it the same as the address shown in the app's settings.

step1.message: Open the Word Garden app for macOS; its settings show “Listening”.

step2.message: Press “Test and save” above and check the address is http://127.0.0.1:3789.

step3.message: Select English on a web page, press the green button, then save the word into your word book.

iosIntro.message: Words you save go into the Word Garden app's inbox first, and land in your word book the next time you open the app. On iOS the app is suspended as soon as it leaves the foreground, so the extension never talks to a local service.

iosNote.message: Meanings come from the dictionary bundled with the extension. If a word isn't in it, it is saved anyway and the app fills in the meaning.

youtubeLauncherHelp.message: Study this video with Word Garden

loadingCaptions.message: Reading the captions visible to this account…

footerTimeline.message: Click a word to mark it Unknown and show its meaning · press Add to word book to submit them together · click a timestamp to play just that line

footerWords.message: Click a word: jump to the next occurrence and replay · tick Unknown: add them to your word book in one go

panelEmptyHint.message: This reads the English captions visible on the YouTube page you are signed in to.

noPlayer.message: Couldn't find the YouTube player. Reload the page and try again.

captionsTimeout.message: Timed out reading captions. Make sure the video has started, or open YouTube's Transcript panel first.

noEnglishWords.message: No English words found in the captions.

captionsRead.message: Read $1$ unique words from this page.

missingGloss.message: $1$ of them still have no meaning — they get one once an AI API key is configured.

addFailed.message: Couldn't add to the word book

errNoVideoPage.message: Open a YouTube video page first.

errPlayerNotReady.message: The YouTube player isn't ready yet. Try again in a moment.

errNoCaptions.message: Found a caption track but read no text. Open YouTube's “Show transcript”, then press reload.

errServiceUnreachable.message: Can't reach the local service at $1$. Make sure the API is running; the default address is http://127.0.0.1:3789.

errRelayRejected.message: The Word Garden app couldn't store this word.

errNoLocalService.message: On iOS the extension doesn't talk to a local service; the meaning is filled in when you open the app.

errNotApiJson.message: That address returned JSON, but it isn't the Word Garden API.

errWrongServiceUrl5173.message: The local service at $1$ returned a web page instead of the API. 5173 is the removed web app port; the extension should connect to http://127.0.0.1:3789.

errWrongServiceUrl.message: The local service at $1$ returned a web page instead of the API. That address looks like a web page; the extension should connect to http://127.0.0.1:3789.

errContentType.message: The local service returned an unrecognised content type ($1$).

errContentTypeBare.message: The local service returned an unrecognised content type.

errInvalidJson.message: The local service returned invalid JSON. Check that it is the Word Garden API.

urlIncomplete.message: Enter a full address, for example http://127.0.0.1:3789.

urlProtocol.message: The local service address must use http:// or https://.

urlUserInfo.message: The local service address can't contain credentials, a query or a fragment.

urlPath.message: Enter the service root address, without a path such as /api/health.

urlPort5173.message: 5173 is the removed web app port, not the API port. Use http://127.0.0.1:3789 instead.
